title: Leadership sync: roadmap priorities and asks (v0.1)
content:
Purpose:
A compact working draft for the leadership sync (week of Mar 15) that:
- Surfaces the critical roadmap tradeoffs across Hosted API, Dedicated, and Private for the next 90 days.
- Presents a single consolidated OKR draft for company review and quick sign-off.
- Lists explicit asks for execs and business partners before the all-hands.

Context / Why now:
- Product cadence drifted in Feb while we stabilized two priority incidents; need to make tradeoffs public and align on scope for Q2->Q3 transition.
- Sales and an early enterprise pilot are asking for Private deployment timeline clarity (legal + infra gating).
- We promised an actionable all-hands with clear commits and owner-level decisions. This doc aims to be the pre-read and the run-of-show input.

Top-level constraints to remind the group:
- Headcount hiring freeze on non-critical IC roles remains through end of Q2.
- Budget flexibility exists for critical infra ops and enterprise support but requires exec approval.
- Goal: keep Hosted velocity while protecting Dedicated/Private roadmap commitments for enterprise pilots.

Proposed all-hands run-of-show (45 minutes total)
- 0-3m: Welcome + TL;DR (CEO) — 3 bullets: revenue traction, major incidents resolved, immediate asks
- 3-12m: Product priorities & roadmap tradeoffs (CPO + eng lead) — 3 short demos/screenshots, one decision table
- 12-22m: OKR snapshot + changes (Head of Strategy) — Present draft company OKRs and rationale, highlight any removals/deferrals
- 22-32m: Customer story + enterprise ask (CS + legal) — status of pilot and gating items
- 32-40m: Operational posture + reliability commitments (SRE) — MTTx improvements, new SLAs for Dedicated
- 40-45m: Explicit asks & next steps (COO) — list of decisions we need by EOW

Draft company OKRs (v0.1) — aim for 3 objectives with measurable key results each
Objective A: Make inference reliably fast and predictable for paying customers
  KR A1: Median p95 latency for text-gen on Hosted down to <120ms for our popular 16k sequence profile (baseline 180ms)
  KR A2: Reduce per-token cost (inference unit) for top-3 models by 20% via batching and kv-cache improvements
  KR A3: Ship SLA contract baseline for Dedicated customers (uptime >= 99.9%) and pilot with 2 customers

Objective B: Grow enterprise adoption while keeping self-serve momentum
  KR B1: MRR from Dedicated/Private contracts >= $350k/mo (new bookings)
  KR B2: Time-to-production for enterprise pilot from contract signature to live <= 8 weeks
  KR3 (team metric): Decrease friction score on onboarding checklist from 4.1 -> 2.5 (survey)

Objective C: Improve developer experience to reduce operating cost and support load
  KR C1: Reduce average token-cost debugging cycle by 30% via better SDK tooling and telemetry
  KR C2: Reduce support tickets tied to onboarding by 40% via improved quickstarts and templates
  KR C3: Launch model-recommendation engine MVP in Optimize with 3 workload templates

Notes on OKR framing / open tradeoffs:
- We should avoid over-indexing on latency KRs that force costly hardware purchases. Prefer software + routing mitigations first.
- A/B testing: proposed to split KR A2 into host-level vs model-level to track where savings come from — open question.
- Revenue KRs tethered to Dedicated/Private need legal/sales alignment on contract terms and payment milestones (see ask below).

Exec updates (short bullets for the all-hands slides):
- Eng (Serving runtime): CL: shipped attention-tiling PR; next week: rollout to canary. Need sign-off on rollback window and perf validation checklist.
- Product: CL: updated model catalog taxonomy; need decision on deprecating legacy small-embed endpoint on Apr 30.
- SRE: CL: improved autoscaler safety limits; ask: approve emergency capacity buffer allocation for Q2 (estimated $75k).
- CS & Sales: CL: pilot signed with AcmeCorp; ask: accelerated legal review for data residency clause (2 week SLA).

Explicit leadership asks (actionable, one-line, owner, desired-by date)
- Approve $75k emergency capacity buffer for Q2 (Noah Kim) — decision by 2026-03-19
- Enable expedited legal review lane for enterprise pilots (Priya Rao) — decision on timeline by 2026-03-22
- Confirm deprecation timeline for legacy embed endpoint or provide customer holdouts (Arjun Patel) — response by 2026-03-25
- Sign-off on Dedicated SLA template (Head of Sales + CTO) — finalize by 2026-03-29

Communications plan (pre-read + post-all-hands)
- Pre-read (this doc + 1-pager) to go out 48h before all-hands. Draft message: high-level bullets, link to Q&A form. Owner: Maya Chen.
- Post all-hands: publish short FAQ and decision log, update public roadmap page. Owner: Leah Martinez.

Open questions (need quick resolution)
- Do we want to conserve engineering focus on Hosted optimizations vs Dedicated features through end of Q2? (ops cost vs sales pressure)
- Are we comfortable publishing the Private deployment timeline publicly or keep it “by request” until legal clears residency?
- Approval process: quick-approve path for infra spend <$100k vs full finance loop (we need clarity).

Next steps (owners & short timeline)
- Maya: finalize pre-read + one-pager, distribute by 2026-03-11
- Noah: cost impact memo for emergency buffer + alternatives (cloud credits, re-prioritization) by 2026-03-16
- Priya: propose legal fast-track process, include SLAs + headcount needs by 2026-03-15
- Arjun: prepare deprecation plan with customer list and mitigation steps by 2026-03-18

Quick checklist for the meeting slide pack (things we must have)
- One-slide decision table with 5 asks and yes/no options
- Short demo video (60s) showing latency improvement on 16k profile
- Customer pilot one-pager with status and blockers
- FAQ draft for post-meeting communication

Notes to self / rough ideas to capture (informal)
- Consider a small canary campaign where enterprise traffic is routed to quantized variants for 2 weeks to measure cost delta.
- Might propose a small internal bounty for teams that reduce per-token cost without hurting eval metrics.
- Keep legal and infra in a short sync before all-hands to avoid last-minute surprises.

End of doc — please add comments inline and flag any objections in the pre-read thread.

-- Maya
